main_model.primary_objective: Maximize lower-tail 5% profit CVaR among eligible strategies.
main_model.expected_profit_constraint: Mean profit cannot be more than 5% of the absolute unhedged mean below the unhedged mean.
main_model.tie_breaker: If CVaR ties, choose the higher expected profit.
